points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions R&S models and source filenames/versions, but not the rule that every claim must cite model and document version or state version absent

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions measurement conditions, options and formal specs, but omits no unit conversion and no self-inferred option compatibility

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: covered
points.why: states warranty status is required and typical/nominal/measured/non-traceable values are not warranted

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state this for signal analyzer specs; only mentions SMA100B generator and omits may change

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: partial
points.why: calls for formal/external evidence, but not the specific rule for R&S-internal-only battle cards needing competitor official and third-party evidence before customer use

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: covered
points.why: says leading/unique/highest coverage need external validation rather than sales positioning alone

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: partial
points.why: lists evidence needed, but does not state the existing battle card lacks competitor datasheet, version, order number, option code, release status and test conditions

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: partial
points.why: says deck/application material is not formal configuration or qualification evidence, but does not fully state satellite/UAV solution mapping is only sales mapping and needs sales kits/application notes/datasheets/proposal

invented: Starlink UT test-flow source maps spectrum analyzer to R&S FSW and Keysight N9040B UXA, and signal generator to R&S SMW200A and Keysight E8257D PSG
Starlink UT recommended-equipment page says those items must be checked in each product datasheet
satellite payload group-delay measurement ... FSW spectrum analyzer and SMW200A signal generator can measure absolute and relative group delay
TVAC or satellite-payload use ... application brochure is solution-level
